```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
invisible(Sys.setlocale("LC_CTYPE", "en_US.UTF-8"))  # else cat() writes non-ASCII as <U+2010> under the C locale
library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(readr); library(knitr); library(here); library(stringr)
source(here("R", "profile.R"))
rdv <- \(f, v) read_csv(proc_path(f, v), show_col_types = FALSE) |> mutate(version = v)
slug <- \(x) str_replace_all(str_to_lower(x), "[^a-z0-9]+", "-")
esc  <- htmltools::htmlEscape
vs   <- PROFILE_VERSIONS
lab  <- PROFILE_LABELS

m  <- bind_rows(lapply(vs, \(v) rdv("metrics_engine.csv", v)))
st <- bind_rows(lapply(vs, \(v) rdv("competition_states.csv", v))) |> filter(state == "ENGINE REGION")
lq <- bind_rows(lapply(vs, \(v) rdv("metrics_lq_cpc.csv", v)))
p1 <- read_csv(here("data", "processed", "tech_profile.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
p3 <- read_csv(here("data", "processed", "tech_profile_v3_1_core.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
cpc_titles <- read_csv(here("data", "reference", "cpc_titles_202608.csv.gz"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(kind %in% c("subclass", "main_group")) |>
  mutate(title = str_remove(title, " \\(.*$")) |>   # subclass titles are in capitals
  transmute(code = str_remove(code, "/00$"), title = if_else(kind == "subclass", str_to_sentence(title), title))

# number of OpenAlex topics and CPC codes per Engine and version
n_items <- bind_rows(
  p1 |> group_by(engine_name) |>
    summarise(topics = n_distinct(na.omit(topic_id)),
              cpc = n_distinct(str_trim(unlist(str_split(na.omit(cpc), ";")))), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(version = "v1"),
  p3 |> filter(in_core) |> group_by(engine_name) |>
    summarise(topics = n_distinct(item_id[kind == "oa"]), cpc = n_distinct(item_id[kind == "cpc"]),
              .groups = "drop") |> mutate(version = "v3_1"))
```

The site shows the knowledge base of each Engine under two technology profiles. Switch between them in the
header (*Profile*): every Engine page, the table of 12 Engines, Publications and Patents exist in both
versions. Papers and patents that are counted "in the profile" (partner papers in the Engine's topics,
regional patents, Patent LQ, the Engine's rank among states) depend on the version; people, partners and
the team's own works and patents do not.

- **v1**: 3-5 technology statements per Engine written by hand from the NSF abstract; OpenAlex topics
  from the OpenAlex classifier (with manual choices), CPC codes chosen by hand, mostly **subclasses**
  (e.g. C22B). The earlier manual choice: it cannot be justified now and is not a benchmark.
- **v3.1, core**: technologies of the grant from its scientific and technical fragments (fixed prompt);
  all OpenAlex topics and all CPC main groups ranked for each technology by rank fusion of independent
  signals; up to 2 topics and 2 CPC **main groups** (e.g. C22B7) per technology; a rubric judge where the
  signals do not agree. The extraction and the judge scores were done by hand in a chat session, not through
  the API, and are not reproducible. See [Methodology](methodology.html).

The broad v3.1 profile (all items above a relevance threshold) and a v2 profile are not built yet.

## Metrics by version

```{r metrics}
w <- m |>
  select(engine_name, version, partner_works_in_topics, partner_works_in_topics_region,
         people_works_in_topics, pat_region_tech, lq_profile, share_region_tech_by_partners) |>
  left_join(st |> select(engine_name, version, rank_patents), by = c("engine_name", "version")) |>
  left_join(n_items, by = c("engine_name", "version")) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = version, values_from = -c(engine_name, version))
col <- \(x, v) paste0(x, "_", v)
w |>
  arrange(engine_name) |>
  transmute(Engine = sprintf("[%s](%s.html)", engine_name, slug(engine_name)),
            `Topics v1` = topics_v1, `Topics v3.1` = topics_v3_1,
            `CPC v1` = cpc_v1, `CPC v3.1` = cpc_v3_1,
            `Partner papers v1` = coalesce(partner_works_in_topics_v1, 0),
            `Partner papers v3.1` = coalesce(partner_works_in_topics_v3_1, 0),
            `Regional patents v1` = pat_region_tech_v1, `Regional patents v3.1` = pat_region_tech_v3_1,
            `Patent LQ v1` = lq_profile_v1, `Patent LQ v3.1` = lq_profile_v3_1,
            `Rank among states v1` = rank_patents_v1, `Rank among states v3.1` = rank_patents_v3_1) |>
  kable(align = c("l", rep("r", 12)))
lq_w <- w |> filter(!is.na(lq_profile_v1), !is.na(lq_profile_v3_1))
both_above <- sum(lq_w$lq_profile_v1 > 1 & lq_w$lq_profile_v3_1 > 1)
both_below <- sum(lq_w$lq_profile_v1 <= 1 & lq_w$lq_profile_v3_1 <= 1)
rho <- cor(lq_w$lq_profile_v1, lq_w$lq_profile_v3_1, method = "spearman")
small <- w |> filter(pat_region_tech_v3_1 < 50) |> arrange(pat_region_tech_v3_1)
```

*Partner papers*: works of the knowledge-producer partners in the Engine's OpenAlex topics since the window
start (Engines without such partners: 0). *Regional patents*: 2021-2025 US grants with an inventor in the
Engine's region and a CPC code of the profile. *Patent LQ*: the region's share of patents in the profile
relative to the US share (1 = US average). *Rank among states*: where the Engine's region would rank among
US states by the number of profile patents.

**Do the conclusions hold?** The Patent LQ is above 1 under both versions for `r both_above` Engines and at
most 1 under both for `r both_below`; the other `r nrow(lq_w) - both_above - both_below` change side. Rank
correlation of the LQ between versions (Spearman): `r sprintf("%.2f", rho)`.
Because v3.1 uses CPC main groups, it counts far fewer patents. Under v3.1, `r nrow(small)` Engines have fewer
than 50 regional patents in the profile (`r paste(sprintf("%s: %d", small$engine_name, small$pat_region_tech_v3_1), collapse = "; ")`);
their LQ rests on few patents and moves a lot with one code.

## Profiles and LQ by code, per Engine

```{r per-engine, results = "asis"}
engines <- engine_first(m$engine_name)
cat('<select id="cmp-engine" class="form-control" style="width:auto; margin-bottom:10px">\n',
    paste0('<option value="', seq_along(engines), '">', esc(engines), "</option>", collapse = "\n"),
    "\n</select>\n\n")
code_title <- \(code) coalesce(cpc_titles$title[match(code, cpc_titles$code)], "")
for (k in seq_along(engines)) {
  e <- engines[k]
  cat(sprintf('<div class="cmp-engine" data-k="%d"%s>\n\n', k, if (k > 1) ' style="display:none"' else ""))
  cat(sprintf("Engine page: [v1](%s.html), [v3.1](v3/%s.html).\n\n", slug(e), slug(e)))

  cat("**v1**: statements, topics and CPC codes\n\n")
  p1 |> filter(engine_name == e) |> arrange(item) |>
    transmute(`#` = item, Statement = statement, `OpenAlex topic` = paste(topic_id, topic), CPC = cpc) |>
    kable(format = "html", table.attr = 'class="table table-condensed"') |> print()

  cat("\n\n**v3.1 core**: technologies of the grant, topics and CPC main groups (*judge* = chosen by the rubric judge)\n\n")
  items <- p3 |> filter(engine_name == e, in_core) |>
    mutate(txt = paste0(esc(item_id), " ", esc(item_title), if_else(str_starts(basis, "judge"), " (judge)", "")))
  p3 |> filter(engine_name == e) |> distinct(tech_id, tech_label) |>
    left_join(items |> filter(kind == "oa") |> group_by(tech_id) |>
                summarise(topics = paste(txt, collapse = "<br>"), .groups = "drop"), by = "tech_id") |>
    left_join(items |> filter(kind == "cpc") |> group_by(tech_id) |>
                summarise(cpc = paste(txt, collapse = "<br>"), .groups = "drop"), by = "tech_id") |>
    arrange(tech_id) |>
    transmute(`#` = tech_id, Technology = esc(tech_label), `OpenAlex topics` = coalesce(topics, ""),
              `CPC main groups` = coalesce(cpc, "")) |>
    kable(format = "html", escape = FALSE, table.attr = 'class="table table-condensed"') |> print()

  cat("\n\n**Patent LQ by CPC code** (2021-2025 grants; regional patents with the code / all regional patents, relative to the US)\n\n")
  lq |> filter(engine_name == e) |> arrange(version, desc(lq)) |>
    transmute(Version = lab[version], CPC = cpc, Title = code_title(cpc),
              `Regional patents` = region_patents, `US patents` = us_patents, LQ = lq) |>
    kable(format = "html", table.attr = 'class="table table-condensed"') |> print()
  cat("\n</div>\n\n")
}
```

<script>
function showCmp(k) {
  document.getElementById("cmp-engine").value = k;
  document.querySelectorAll(".cmp-engine").forEach(function (d) {
    d.style.display = d.getAttribute("data-k") === String(k) ? "" : "none";
  });
}
document.getElementById("cmp-engine").addEventListener("change", function () {
  showCmp(this.value);
  history.replaceState(null, "", "#engine-" + this.value);
});
window.addEventListener("load", function () {
  var m = location.hash.match(/^#engine-(\d+)$/);
  if (m) showCmp(m[1]);
});
</script>
